lora_initialization: PEFT default: Kaiming-uniform A, zero B

source.selection: exclude train caption overlap, blank/duplicate/cf/violin; require native trigger visibility; fixed seeded shuffle; first 200
source.evaluation_scope: external cross-corpus prompts; not in-distribution Recraft holdout

trainable.exclusion: final transformer proj_out; all other torch.nn.Linear included

protocol: supervised uniform-time flow velocity LoRA; not BadReward reproduction
precision: BF16 frozen weights and cache; FP32 LoRA and optimizer
optimizer: AdamW, beta=(0.9,0.999), eps=1e-8, weight_decay=0, fresh states
checkpoint_policy: adapter every 20 updates and final; also every dense point in full protocol
evaluation_policy: 60 fixed probes; trigger each 100 and final; clean only 0/final
gradient_gate: finite and strictly nonzero at every optimizer update
measurement_changes: 20 denoising steps at 512px instead of official 40-step/1024px example
synthetic_label_limitation: synthetic requested attributes, not human ground truth
